## Vehicle weight and fuel efficiency

This plot uses the built-in `mtcars` data set to compare vehicle weight with
fuel efficiency, with point color indicating the number of cylinders.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Weight (1,000 lb)",
    y = "Fuel efficiency (mpg)",
    color = "Cylinders",
    title = "Heavier cars tend to use more fuel"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```This line was written on a second machine.
